NO CHARACTER SHEET · NO INSTALL · PLAYABLE NOW

Your Five-Layer Cube Is Both Your Build and Your Life.

RPG³ replaces paper arithmetic with a spatial five-layer 5x5 Cube. Place stone tiles across Attribute, Experience, Skill, Equipment, and Inventory layers. Touching tiles multiply your strength, incoming blows flip live tiles face-down, and every Action Card in your hand comes straight from the gear, skills, and bonded Sprite sitting face-up on your board.

SPATIAL TENSION

Adjacency Beats Arithmetic

Health, Strength, Finesse, and Arcane root in the four corners while Spirit bridges neighbors. A lone tile scores 1, two touching score 3, and three touching score 5. Every hit you take is a tactical choice over which cluster you can afford to fracture.

WALKOVER OR SLIDER

Earned Mastery & Push-Your-Luck

Outclass a foe's Target Defense and you spend 1 Ready die for an automatic Walkover hit. In contested clashes, set your own Difficulty Slider (1 to 10) and roll Cost (<=) against Effect (>=) to balance extra tile flips against dice thrift.

LIVING FRONTIER

Sprites, Field Forges & Four Peoples

Wild Sprites run on the same five-layer Cube rules as players. Leave a defeated Sprite helpless to open a bonding rite, or strike a 1-die Finishing Blow to gather crystal charge, ignite a field-forge glow, and open four rounds of rapid North-Ridge harvesting.

WORLD OF ANIMUS · THREE-RING 7-MONTH CYCLE ECOLOGY

Three Permanent Capitols in a World Remade Every Seven Months

Across Animus, a planetary 7-Month Cycle sweeps the wild frontier clean and reseeds its terrain, resources, and Sprite territories. Civilization endures inside three distinct Capitol Sanctuaries, steps out into a rookie-friendly one-mile Gate-Halo, and mounts fresh expeditions into the remade outer wilds every season.

INNER CORE · PERMANENT

Three Sanctuary Shells

Angel's Rest is the sole Capitol sheltered beneath an external hemispherical Arcane Sanctuary Bubble. By contrast, Karsthold's living mountain massif and Veridome's braided living-ironwood dome are themselves the Cycle-proof Sanctuaries, with zero external bubbles and zero permanent stone outside their gates.

RING 1 · ~1 MILE GATE-HALO

Rookie-Tunable Foothills

Ambient Sanctuary aspect bleed keeps the first mile outside each Capitol gate steady and readable for new Red and Fresh-Orange crews. After each reset, Land-Rush teams re-stake canvas bazaars, timber sled chutes, quarry rigs, and sunny pear-wall orchards across the local halo.

RING 2+ · OUTER EXPEDITION WILDS

100% Wiped & Re-Seeded

Beyond one mile, every seven months wipes 100% of roads, quarries, and camps clean, repopulating crags, washes, and Cycle-surviving shallow ruins from the 180-species wild catalog. Yesterday's safe trail is tomorrow's untamed territory.

ASYMMETRIC BONDING · ONE CUBE & FIVE DICE PER PLAYER

Four Playable Peoples, Four Distinct Ways to Bond a Sprite

Bonding a wild Sprite never saddles a player with a second character sheet or extra turn bookkeeping. Every player acts inside the same five-die round budget, while each People anchors its bonded partner onto a different physical surface of the game.

VISUAL LAW · READY INK (#26231F) & SPENT GREY (#9A958D)

Interactive Dual-Face Starters, Boss & Quartermaster Kit

Every glyph in RPG³ carries two hand-inked faces over a procedural wet-in-wet watercolor wash keyed to the attribute the piece requires: crisp solid ink while Ready and face-up on your Cube, and cool stone grey once flipped Spent by incoming hits, deliberate bursts, or stowing. Click any plate below to flip its state, or inspect the full cutout.

OPEN COHORT PROTOCOL

How a Playtest Session Runs

  1. Open the Browser Table: Launch Web-Box-0 on desktop or tablet. For zero-friction group play, one host shares their window on Discord or Zoom; for multi-browser tables, click Host Room URL to share a live seat link.
  2. Run Two Contracts & Bond a Partner: Pick two local Guild contracts from the East-Gate Quest Board, vote openly on pooled Experience, place your first Spirit tile, and bond one of six Prime Starters.
  3. Pass Your Clearance Exam: Spar Sergeant Hal in a non-lethal coaching bout or test your Cube against Collina on the North-Ridge hex map.
  4. Export Your Telemetry JSON: Open the Log tab, score Cool and Fun (1 to 10), jot two honest friction or highlight notes, and click Export Telemetry (.json).
For Publishers, Manufacturers & Convention Organizers: RPG³ is prototyped digitally first so table pacing is proven before injection-molded or 3D-printed Cube tooling locks. Animus world IP, digital CRPG/MMORPG rights, and creator platform rights remain wholly studio-held; tabletop co-publishing, convention playtest pods, and physical Cube manufacturing inquiries are welcome via the Scout tab.
